verdict.rationale: Browserbase is fundamentally an API/infrastructure product—session creation, control, observability, web search, scraping, and agent actions are all exposed via API/SDK (docs-1,4,5,8-20), plus official MCP server and CLI for programmatic access. The dashboard is a thin layer over API-created sessions, so there's no UI-exclusive functionality evidenced, though no formal OpenAPI spec is discoverable (probe-2).
